moves.label: Trade: Jae Crowder, George Hill, Serge Ibaka, Jordan Nwora, Kevin Durant and others
moves.description: Jae Crowder was acquired by the Milwaukee Bucks in exchange for George Hill, Serge Ibaka, Jordan Nwora, a More Favorable 2023 2nd round pick, a 2024 2nd round pick (MIL own), a 2025 2nd round pick (IND own), a 2028 2nd round pick (MIL own) and a 2029 2nd round pick (MIL own). Kevin Durant and T.J. Warren were acquired by the Phoenix Suns in exchange for Mikal Bridges, Jae Crowder, Cameron Johnson, a 2023 1st round pick (PHX own), a 2025 1st round pick (PHX own), a 2027 1st round pick (PHX own), a Swap 2028 1st round picks and a 2029 1st round pick (PHX own). George Hill, Serge Ibaka, Jordan Nwora, a More Favorable 2023 2nd round pick, a 2024 2nd round pick (MIL own), a 2025 2nd round pick (IND own) and cash were acquired by the Indiana Pacers in exchange for the draft rights to Juan Vaulet. Mikal Bridges, Cameron Johnson, the draft rights to Juan Vaulet, a 2023 1st round pick (PHX own), a 2025 1st round pick (PHX own), a 2027 1st round pick (PHX own), a Swap 2028 1st round picks, a 2028 2nd round pick (MIL own), a 2029 1st round pick (PHX own), a 2029 2nd round pick (MIL own) and multiple TPEs were acquired by the Brooklyn Nets in exchange for Kevin Durant, T.J. Warren and cash.

moves.label: Trade: Bradley Beal, Jordan Goodwin, Isaiah Todd, Chris Paul, Landry Shamet and others
moves.description: Bradley Beal, Jordan Goodwin and Isaiah Todd were acquired by the Phoenix Suns in exchange for Chris Paul, Landry Shamet, a Swap 2028 1st round picks, a Swap 2024 1st round picks, a 2024 2nd round pick (PHX own), a 2025 2nd round pick (PHX own), a Swap 2026 1st round picks, a 2026 2nd round pick (PHX own), a 2027 2nd round pick (PHX own), a 2028 2nd round pick (PHX own), a Swap 2030 1st round picks, a 2030 2nd round pick (PHX own) and cash. The draft rights to Jarace Walker, a 2028 2nd round pick (PHX own) and a 2029 2nd round pick (WAS own) were acquired by the Indiana Pacers in exchange for the draft rights to Bilal Coulibaly. Chris Paul, Landry Shamet, the draft rights to Bilal Coulibaly, a Swap 2028 1st round picks, a Swap 2024 1st round picks, a 2024 2nd round pick (PHX own), a 2025 2nd round pick (PHX own), a Swap 2026 1st round picks, a 2026 2nd round pick (PHX own), a 2027 2nd round pick (PHX own), a Swap 2030 1st round picks, a 2030 2nd round pick (PHX own), cash and multiple TPEs were acquired by the Washington Wizards in exchange for Bradley Beal, Jordan Goodwin, Isaiah Todd, the draft rights to Jarace Walker, a 2029 2nd round pick (WAS own) and a TPE.

moves.label: Trade: Hunter Tyson, Maxwell Lewis, Mojave King, Jalen Pickett, Julian Strawther and others
moves.description: A conditional 2029 1st round pick (DEN own) was acquired by the Oklahoma City Thunder in exchange for the draft rights to Hunter Tyson, a Least Favorable 2024 1st round pick and a Least Favorable 2024 2nd round pick. The draft rights to Maxwell Lewis was acquired by the Los Angeles Lakers in exchange for the draft rights to Mojave King and cash. The draft rights to Jalen Pickett, the draft rights to Julian Strawther, the draft rights to Hunter Tyson and a Least Favorable 2024 2nd round pick were acquired by the Denver Nuggets in exchange for the draft rights to Maxwell Lewis and a conditional 2029 1st round pick (DEN own). The draft rights to Mojave King, a Least Favorable 2024 1st round pick and cash were acquired by the Indiana Pacers in exchange for the draft rights to Jalen Pickett and the draft rights to Julian Strawther.
